executive_summary.text: Market size (TAM): USD 1.8 billion (AI crop disease detection market, 2025).
Demand: Most small farmers say they lose crops because diseases are spotted late.
Priority segment: Smallholder farmers. They feel the crop losses most directly.
5 competitors found: 2 direct, 2 indirect and 1 emerging.
Possible gap (medium confidence, a hypothesis): Few competitors show treatment advice tailored to the diagnosed disease.
Main limitation: A free photo diagnosis app is already available.
